Bug (3) lazy loading: WORKING (Home loads only bundle.js; visiting /admin/login triggers a new src_pages_AdminLogin_jsx.chunk.js; no admin chunks appear on / ). Bug (4) ScrollToTop: WORKING (scroll-from-bottom then click footer link results in scrollY of 0/85/0 on /about, /contact, /donate; hash deep link /resources/domestic-violence#safe-harbor-24-7-helpline still scrolls to anchor at Y=735). Header logo overlap regression: no regression (16px gap at 1280 and 1920). BUG (1) em-dashes: NOT FIXED - every page still renders at least one U+2014 em-dash. Sources still emit em-dashes: Footer.jsx:40, VerseShuffleButton.jsx:92, Ministries.jsx:168, LightACandle.jsx:209, Beatitudes.jsx:86 and :133, plus a literal '\u2014' in lib/shareKit.js:91 (canvas draw for share cards). action_items: Fix em-dash bug: replace the HTML entity `—` with a regular hyphen `-` in: /app/frontend/src/components/Footer.jsx:40, /app/frontend/src/components/VerseShuffleButton.jsx:92, /app/frontend/src/pages/Ministries.jsx:168, /app/frontend/src/pages/LightACandle.jsx:209, /app/frontend/src/pages/Beatitudes.jsx:86 and :133. Also replace the literal U+2014 in /app/frontend/src/lib/shareKit.js:91 with '-'. A single command that catches all: `grep -rln 'mdash\|\u2014' /app/frontend/src` then sed both patterns.
Consider updating /app/frontend/public/manifest.json to lowercase 'ministries' and replace its em-dash for consistency with the site branding.
Investigate the pre-existing 404s from /api/blog and /api/candles in the preview backend - out of scope for this iteration but affects those pages.
critical_code_review_comments: The text sweep in the review request should have used a regex covering both U+2014 and — (and —). Recommend adding a small unit / grep check in CI to prevent regression: `! grep -rn '\u2014\|mdash\|#8212' /app/frontend/src`.

ScrollToTop uses behavior:'instant' which is only recently supported in some browsers; older Safari treats unknown values as 'auto' which happens to be instant anyway, so this is fine, but consider dropping the option entirely (default behavior is instant).
Suspense fallback is a full-screen dark spinner that flashes on every route transition on slow networks. Consider a lightweight top-bar/skeleton to avoid the whole page going blank.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bugs (2), (3), (4) are working correctly - do not re-test them unless main agent touched App.js / ScrollToTop.jsx again. Only re-verify bug (1) after the — entities are replaced. Quick verification command in browser: `document.body.innerText.split('\u2014').length - 1` should be 0 on /, /about, /ministries, /light-a-candle, /notary at minimum. Also grep-guard: `grep -rn 'mdash' /app/frontend/src` should return no results.
rca of the issue: Main agent's sed sweep only searched for the actual U+2014 codepoint in source files. But most of this codebase writes em-dashes using the HTML entity `—` (a common React/JSX pattern to avoid unicode literals in source). React parses `—` and emits U+2014 into the DOM at render time, so the source stays 'clean' by the sed grep but the browser still shows em-dashes on every page. Fix: replace `—` occurrences with a plain '-' (with the surrounding spaces the layout already provides), and also fix the one literal U+2014 in lib/shareKit.js used inside a canvas fillText.
